name: Ship ClickUp requirements to production with Claude, Cursor and GitHub

parameters.content:
## AI Requirements → Production Autonomous SDLC Agent

A ClickUp task tagged 'ready-for-ai' flows end-to-end: Claude analyzes the requirement (and asks for clarification if it's ambiguous), designs an architecture, breaks it into subtasks, hands implementation to a Cursor background agent, runs the test suite (looping fixes back to Cursor on failure), opens a PR, runs a security scan, waits for human approval, merges + deploys, then verifies production health — with an automatic rollback + re-verify loop if health doesn't hold.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: ClickUp API, Anthropic API (header auth, x-api-key), Cursor API (header auth), GitHub API, CI platform (header auth), security scanner (header auth), deployment platform (header auth), APM/monitoring (header auth), WhatsApp Business Cloud API on every WhatsApp node
3. Edit Set - Config: clickupListId, repoOwner/repoName, cursorApiUrl, ciDispatchUrl, securityScanUrl, deploymentApiUrl, productionHealthApiUrl, maxImplementationAttempts, whatsapp fields
4. Point every Wait node's resume webhook at the matching external event: ClickUp comment reply (clarification), Cursor completion webhook, CI results webhook, security scan results webhook, human approval tool, deployment-complete webhook
5. Activate, or use Manual Trigger with a sample ClickUp task id to test end to end

### Requirements
- ClickUp API access (tasks/comments)
- Anthropic API access (Claude)
- Cursor API access (background agents)
- GitHub API access (branches, PRs, merges)
- CI platform API + webhook (test runs)
- Security scanner API + webhook (SAST/dependency scan)
- Deployment platform API + webhook (CD pipeline)
- APM/monitoring API access (post-deploy health)
- WhatsApp Business Cloud API credentials

### A note on autonomy boundaries
This workflow automates analysis, implementation, and verification, but keeps two hard human gates: PR approval before merge, and rollback still notifies a human even though it self-triggers. Nothing merges or stays deployed without a human-visible checkpoint.

## 1. Intake & Requirement Analysis (with clarification loop)

- **Webhook - ClickUp Requirement Ready** — starts the flow when a ClickUp task is tagged 'ready-for-ai'.
- **Manual Trigger - Test Run** — lets you run the whole workflow on demand for testing.
- **Set - Config** — central place for ClickUp/repo/API URLs, thresholds, and WhatsApp settings.
- **HTTP Request - Fetch ClickUp Requirement Details** — pulls the full task body, description, and comments. 🔑
- **HTTP Request - Claude: Analyze Requirement** — asks Claude for a clarity score, acceptance criteria, and open questions. 🔑
- **JS - Parse Requirement Analysis** — safely parses Claude's JSON analysis.
- **IF - Requirement Clear Enough** — branches on clarity score and whether open questions remain.
- **HTTP Request - Post Clarification Comment to ClickUp** — posts Claude's open questions back to the task. 🔑
- **Wait - For Human Clarification** — pauses until someone replies in ClickUp, then loops back to re-analyze.

## 2. Architecture & Task Breakdown

- **HTTP Request - Claude: Design Architecture** — asks Claude for affected services, data model/API changes, and risk notes. 🔑
- **JS - Parse Architecture Output** — safely parses Claude's architecture JSON.
- **HTTP Request - Claude: Break Down Into Tasks** — turns the architecture into an ordered list of implementation subtasks. 🔑
- **JS - Parse Task Breakdown & Fan Out Subtasks** — parses the task list and fans it out into one item per subtask.
- **HTTP Request - Create ClickUp Subtask** — creates one ClickUp subtask per item (runs once per subtask). 🔑
- **Aggregate - Recombine After Subtask Creation** — folds the fanned-out subtask items back into one.
- **JS - Rebuild Single Feature-Level State** — rebuilds the single feature-level state for the implementation stage.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Cursor Implementation & Test Loop

parameters.content:
## 3. Implementation & Test-Fix Loop

- **HTTP Request - Trigger Cursor Background Agent** — hands the architecture and task breakdown to Cursor to implement. 🔑
- **Wait - For Cursor Implementation Complete** — pauses until Cursor pushes a branch.
- **HTTP Request - Trigger CI Test Suite** — dispatches the test run on the pushed branch. 🔑
- **Wait - For CI Test Results** — pauses until the CI webhook reports results.
- **JS - Evaluate Test Results & Track Attempts** — parses pass/fail and increments the attempt counter.
- **IF - Tests Passed** — branches to PR creation on pass, or to the attempts check on fail.
- **IF - Max Attempts Reached** — branches to a human alert if attempts are exhausted, or retries Cursor.
- **HTTP Request - Send Failure Feedback to Cursor Agent** — sends the failure log back to Cursor for another attempt. 🔑
- **WhatsApp - Alert Implementation Failed** — escalates to a human once the auto-fix loop is exhausted. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Implementation Failed** — marks the case as needing human takeover.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - PR, Security Scan & Approval Gate

parameters.content:
## 4. Pull Request, Security Scan & Human Approval

- **HTTP Request - Create Pull Request** — opens the PR from the Cursor branch against the base branch. 🔑
- **JS - Carry PR Details Forward** — carries the PR number and URL forward into the state.
- **HTTP Request - Trigger Security Scan** — kicks off SAST/dependency scanning on the PR. 🔑
- **Wait - For Security Scan Results** — pauses until the scanner's webhook reports results.
- **JS - Evaluate Security Scan Results** — parses severity counts from the scan findings.
- **IF - Security Scan Passed** — branches to human approval, or to a security-blocked alert.
- **WhatsApp - Alert Security Blocked** — notifies a human that critical/high findings need manual triage. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Security Blocked** — marks the case as blocked pending manual triage.
- **WhatsApp - Request Human Approval** — sends the PR link and summary for human approval. 🔑
- **Wait - For Approval Confirmation** — pauses until the reviewer approves or rejects.
- **IF - Approved** — gates merge on the human approval decision.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Deployment & Production Verification Loop

parameters.content:
## 5. Merge, Deploy & Production Verification

- **HTTP Request - Close PR (Rejected)** — closes the PR if the reviewer rejected it. 🔑
- **WhatsApp - Notify Rejected** — notifies that the PR was rejected and closed. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Rejected** — marks the case as rejected.
- **HTTP Request - Merge Pull Request** — merges the PR once approved. 🔑
- **HTTP Request - Trigger Deployment Pipeline** — kicks off the CD pipeline. 🔑
- **Wait - For Deployment Complete** — pauses until the deployment webhook reports completion.
- **HTTP Request - Fetch Production Health Metrics** — pulls post-deploy error rate, latency, and uptime. 🔑
- **JS - Evaluate Production Health** — compares the metrics against baseline health thresholds.
- **IF - Production Healthy** — branches to success closure, or to automatic rollback.
- **HTTP Request - Update ClickUp Task (Done)** — closes the loop in ClickUp with a summary. 🔑
- **WhatsApp - Send Success Summary** — notifies the team that the feature shipped successfully. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Closed Success** — marks the case as closed and successful.
- **HTTP Request - Trigger Automatic Rollback** — immediately rolls back the deployment on unhealthy metrics. 🔑
- **WhatsApp - Alert Rollback Triggered** — notifies the team that an automatic rollback has started. 🔑
- **Wait - For Post-Rollback Verification Grace Period** — pauses to give the rollback time to take effect.
- **HTTP Request - Re-Fetch Production Health** — re-checks production health after the rollback. 🔑
- **JS - Evaluate Post-Rollback Health** — compares post-rollback metrics against the same health thresholds.
- **IF - Rollback Successful** — branches to recovery confirmation, or to a critical-incident alert.
- **WhatsApp - Send Rollback Recovery Confirmed** — confirms the rollback restored production health. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Rolled Back Safe** — marks the case as rolled back safely, pending rework.
- **WhatsApp - Alert Rollback Not Recovering** — escalates as a critical incident if rollback didn't restore health. 🔑
- **Set - Case Status Critical Incident** — marks the case as a critical incident needing human response.
